schema.pops.title: Population
schema.pops.name: Population of a province
schema.pops.doc: Blocks in history/pops/<date>/*.txt: one per province and date, with one population group (POP) for each type, culture and religion. Its id is «<date>:<province>».
schema.pop.title: Population groups
schema.pop.name: Population group
schema.pop.doc: One population group inside its province block: the key is its type.
